name: Buried History
niche: bizarre, dark, and forgotten true history facts told in 30s vertical shorts — strong hooks, sound-off captions
voice: Mystical and thrilling, with a touch of the macabre in its storytelling approach.
audience: History enthusiasts, mystery lovers, and those who enjoy a good ghost story or urban legend.
do: Tell captivating stories, use sound effects for impact, include intriguing visuals, provide surprising facts.
avoid: Avoid being too dry or academic, steer clear of mundane or well-known history facts, do not include clickbait titles.
pillars: Forgotten cities, haunted places, unsolved mysteries
